findings.title: No lead path for the J440 (AUX) harness on the shared west edge

evidence.coordinates_mm: Board frame x=0 west, y=0 aft (ORDERING 8.1). J440 pins at (7.4, 11.0/14.5/18.0/21.5), wire face x=3.40, envelope y 7.93-23.45. Next along x=0, going forward: J3 USB-C envelope y 26.33-35.27 (a USB-C plug overmold up to 12.35 mm wide, centred near y 30.8, takes about y 24.6-37.0 beyond the edge: USB-IF maximum, Inference); J2 TC2030 y 37.4-41.4; the (4,44.3) washer and head with a 3.8 mm radius cover x 0.2-7.8, y 40.5-48.1, i.e. the whole 3.4 mm edge strip; J121 igniter wires y 54.1/57.6; J400 switch wires 64.1/67.6; J1 battery 74.1/77.6. Going aft: the (4,4) washer covers y 0.2-7.8 of the strip, and the aft edge is the OQ-7 boundary (board wholly forward of joint+47), with the camera shroud at joint+4..+47 within 18.4 mm of the axis (VEHICLE.md) on an unclocked side, while the J440 wire face is 19.6 mm off the axis.
evidence.measured_value: J440 wire room 5.003 mm (5.00-5.60 with sled tolerance), as on every DB125. ORDERING 8.4 gives a lead rule for the battery (west row, 'dress apart', clear of the forward-west washer), the J400 pair (own ties, away from the battery and servo leads) and the external modules ('keep radio/harness away from the CH1 cell'), but not a lead path for J440. The handoff says only 'fit ... any AUX module ... harness ... together'.
evidence.maker_url: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification Rel 2.x, plug overmold maximum 12.35 x 6.5 mm (Inference: not re-read for this review)

findings.impact: J440 is the first lead group at the aft-west corner. Its only exits are forward along x=0 or aft past the board's aft edge. Forward, a 4-wire bundle (PORT_4V8, GND, UART; possibly the radio, if it is moved there, which D-R19-14 allows) would cross the USB-C plug zone, ride over the (4,44.3) screw head, and then run beside the J121 igniter and J400 switch exits, contrary to the 8.4 dressing rules. Aft, it enters the battery-lead and camera-shroud zone right at the OQ-7 boundary. Neither is a demonstrated failure, and physical harness fit is already listed as pending. But an installer has no rule, and the natural forward route breaks two existing ones.
findings.concrete_fix: Docs only (ORDERING 8.4 new 'AUX / J440 leads' row, plus the handoff 'Position in the stack, pack and harness' section): J440 leads leave west, turn aft over or around the (4,4) nylon head, stay south of y 23.5 (clear of the USB-C plug zone), and leave past the aft edge on the side away from the camera shroud, tied to the sled. Never run them forward along x=0 past J3, J121 or J400. If the radio or GPS is moved to J440, the same route applies, and its module stays away from the CH1 cell. Record the chosen route in the physical fit check.
